# `<util/zxf.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

ZXF, zuzu's executable container: header, segment table and optional blocks.

```c
#include <util/zxf.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="zxf_r"></a>`ZXF_R` | `1` | Segment flag: readable. |
| <a id="zxf_w"></a>`ZXF_W` | `2` | Segment flag: writable. |
| <a id="zxf_x"></a>`ZXF_X` | `4` | Segment flag: executable. |

## Enumerations

### `ZXFArch` { #zxfarch }

Target architecture of an image.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ARM32` | `1` | 32-bit ARM. |
| `ARM64` | `2` | 64-bit ARM. |
| `X86_64` | `3` | x86-64. |
| `RISCV` | `4` | RISC-V. |
| `POWPC` | `5` | PowerPC. |

### `ZXFBlockType` { #zxfblocktype }

Kind of an optional block.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DYNLINK` | `1` | A zuzu common library (ZCL). |
| `HINTS` | `2` | Loader hints. |
| `DEBUGINFO` | `3` | Debug symbols. |
| `SIGNATURE` | `4` | Signature. |

### `ZXFBlockFlag` { #zxfblockflag }

Whether a loader may ignore a block it does not understand.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OPTIONAL` | `0` | Safe to ignore. |
| `REQUIRED` | `1` | Must be understood, or the image is rejected. |

## Structures

### `ZXFHeader` { #zxfheader }

ZXF file header (64 bytes, at offset 0).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `magic` | `uint8_t` | File magic. |
| `version` | `uint8_t` | Format version. |
| `arch` | `uint8_t` | Target architecture, a [ZXFArch](#zxfarch). |
| `flags` | `uint8_t` | Image flags. |
| `reserved` | `uint8_t` | Must be zero. |
| `entry` | `uint64_t` | Entry point address. |
| `load_base` | `uint64_t` | Lowest load address. |
| `image_size` | `uint32_t` | Total file size in bytes. |
| `seg_count` | `uint16_t` | Entries in the segment table. |
| `block_count` | `uint16_t` | Entries in the block table. |
| `seg_table_offset` | `uint32_t` | File offset of the segment table. |
| `block_table_offset` | `uint32_t` | File offset of the block table. |
| `checksum` | `uint32_t` | Image checksum. |
| `build_id` | `uint8_t` | Build identifier. |
| `reserved2` | `uint8_t` | Must be zero. |

### `ZXFSegment` { #zxfsegment }

One loadable segment (24 bytes).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `file_offset` | `uint32_t` | Offset of the segment's bytes in the file. |
| `file_size` | `uint32_t` | Bytes present in the file. |
| `vaddr` | `uint64_t` | Load address. |
| `mem_size` | `uint32_t` | Size in memory; the part beyond file_size is zero-filled. |
| `flags` | `uint8_t` | ZXF_R / ZXF_W / ZXF_X. |
| `align` | `uint8_t` | Alignment, as a power of two. |
| `reserved` | `uint16_t` | Must be zero. |

### `ZXFImage` { #zxfimage }

A parsed ZXF image, pointing into the caller's buffer.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `base` | `const uint8_t *` | Start of the image bytes. |
| `size` | `size_t` | Image size in bytes. |
| `entry` | `uint32_t` | Entry point address. |
| `seg_count` | `uint16_t` | Number of segments. |
| `segs` | const [`ZXFSegment`](#zxfsegment) * | The segment table, inside the image. |

### `ZXFBlock` { #zxfblock }

Entry in the block table (12 bytes).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `uint16_t` | A [ZXFBlockType](#zxfblocktype). |
| `flags` | `uint16_t` | A [ZXFBlockFlag](#zxfblockflag). |
| `offset` | `uint32_t` | File offset of the block. |
| `size` | `uint32_t` | Block size in bytes. |

## Functions

### `ZxfParse` { #zxfparse }

```c
bool ZxfParse(const void *data, size_t size, ZXFImage *out);
```

Validates a ZXF image and describes it.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `data` | in | Image bytes. |
| `size` | in | Image size in bytes. |
| `out` | out | Filled on success; points into `data`. |

**Returns:** true if `data` is a valid ZXF image.
